findings.text: test_a_manifest_commit_at_or_below_the_base_is_named passes at the dispatch base as well (logs/baseline_suite.log reads FF.F., so only cases 1, 2 and 4 are red there), because the old exact-set rule already named base and below; it preserves the rule the done_when asks for but is not itself a regression guard, so the durability of the base-boundary half rests on the head-coverage case and its negative control.

presented_declines suppresses the whole shortfall report as soon as any presented commit is outside the manifest's list, so a promotion presenting the run's head together with one unrelated commit reports nothing about genuinely missing declared commits; the shape is carried over from the previous strict-subset condition rather than introduced here, and the docstring at :840-843 states it deliberately as the declined-revision case.
